text: New Zealand's Orana Wildlife Park is the country's only open-range zoo . The video was captured by Ekant Veer, 35, an associate professor at the University of Canterbury . It shows the lions interacting with the visitors who stand inside a metal cage attached to a car . One lion scales the cage and looks down at the people below as if deciding who it would like to eat .

Wales climbed to 22, their highest-ever position in football's world order, in the April rankings to move within eight places of England . Chris Coleman's side are unbeaten in Euro 2016 qualifying and would be within touching distance of the finals in France if they beat Belgium in June . Aaron Ramsey admits the banter with the likes of Theo Walcott, Jack Wilshere and Danny Welbeck is already flying on the Arsenal training ground .

Stoke chief executive Tony Scholes is hopeful they can keep hold of Asmir Begovic . The Bosnia international has regularly been linked with other clubs during his time at the Britannia Stadium . Scholes believes they can match the 27-year-old's ambitions at Stoke .

John Carver has challenged his Newcastle players to relieve the pressure on their shoulders with a win against Liverpool . Liverpool have slipped out of the top four and out of Champions League contention . The Magpies head to Anfield on Monday night to keep alive their hopes of a top-four finish . The Reds ended their mini-slump with a 1-0 FA Cup quarter-final win at Blackburn .

Gina Maria Schumacher was one of the participants in the NRHA European Futurity Horse Show in the Bavarian town of Kreuth yesterday afternoon . The 17-year-old was seen riding a number of different horses as she took part in what is known as the 'First Go-Round 2nd Section' yesterday . She is expected to take part in the grand final of the tournament on Saturday evening . Comes just days after her brother Mick returned to the racing circuit just weeks after he was involved in a 100mph crash .

The high-grossing blockbuster directed by Clint Eastwood was originally scheduled to be shown during a student mixer Friday, but the university decided to cancel the screening over complaints that American Sniper portrays Muslims as villains . Sophomore Lamees Mekkaoui started a petition saying the subject of the film, the late Navy SEAL Chris Kyle, was 'mass killer' and 'a racist' The school tweeted out a statement saying the ‘decision to cancel not consistent w/high value @Umich places on freedom of expression’ Now, American Sniper will be screened separately from the UMix Late Night event, 'in a forum that provides for dialogue and reflection,' the Center for Campus Inv

Mike Whitehead was standing against Labour's Alan Johnson in the Hull West and Hessle constituency in Yorkshire . He said he was 'disgusted' at the behaviour of the ruling Conservative group in his area . But the Tories this morning revealed they had already dropped Mr Whitehead as their candidate . Ukip said: 'This is typical Ukip – cynical, misleading and utterly calculating to try and score political points' Nigel Farage claimed the scalp was 'another hammer blow' for David Cameron .

Aeman Presley, 34, faces charges for the killing of two homeless men in Atlanta, another man sleeping outdoors in DeKalb County and a hairdresser in a parking garage in Decatur . District attorneys in both counties have said they will seek the death penalty .

Harold Ekeh, 18, is a straight A student at Elmont Memorial High School in Long Island, New York . He has been accepted by all 13 Ivy League schools, including Harvard, Yale, Harvard, Columbia, Cornell, Princeton, Princeton and NYU . The Nigerian-born Harold and his parents moved to the US when he was eight years ago . He says his parents' struggle to fit in inspired him to take every opportunity he was given . He plans to be a neurosurgeon to study Alzheimer's, a disease his grandmother suffers from .

Leon Yeaman, 55, was allegedly killed by a single punch in the head from 28-year-old Phillip Pama, 28, during a row in front of their north Brisbane homes on Thursday night . Mr Yeaman was reportedly in his yard on Muller Road making a lot of noise at around 9pm on Thursday . Pama's defence lawyer Bruce Peters said his client grabbed his neighbour by the hand and hit out ‘blindly’ The Samoan man was ordered to surrender his passport, aherre to a curfew from 6pm to 2am and report to the local police station twice a week .

Jamie Silvonek, 14, and Army Spc Caleb Barnes, 20, have been charged with homicide and criminal conspiracy in the murder of her mother, 54-year-old Cheryl Silvonk, who was stabbed to death March 15 . The girl's mother found out about their relationship in early March and ordered the couple to break up, according to court documents . The teen texted Barnes hours before the stabbing, 'She threatened to throw me out of the house. I want her gone,' the documents said . The 14th-grader's attorney said the girl tearfully told him she missed her mother and claimed she was coerced by her soldier boyfriend and afraid for her life .

Barcelona beat Paris St Germain 3-1 in the Champions League quarter-final first leg . Andres Iniesta was substituted after a clash with Javier Pastore . The Spain international could now miss Saturday's La Liga game with Valencia . Barca are two points clear of Real Madrid, who host Malaga later on Saturday .

The 11-year-old boy with autism is seen drawing the intricate map of the world from scratch . He is the son of a professor in New York who invited his autistic son to one of her classes . The world map was highly accurate and included details such as political borders and tiny coastal islands .

Marlon Samuels and Kraigg Brathwaite saw West Indies into credit and within sight of another draw with only the final Test in Barbados next week to play . England go into the last day needing eight wickets to have any chance of victory . England were all out when Jimmy Anderson strolled back to his wicket which led to his run out . Earlier, Joe Root had been left stranded with one of the doziest pieces of cricket imaginable as England threw away their chance of reaching 500 .

Harley Jolly, Tyson Barr and Nic Roy – known collectively as Slide Christchurch – videoed themselves descending Dunedin’s Baldwin Street on three-wheeled vehicles known as 'slide trikes' Baldwin Street is 350 metres long and is officially recognised by the Guinness Book of Records as the world's steepest with a 35% gradient . The sleeves wrapped around the tyres are what allow the group to control their slide while drifting .

Hafeez Batthi, 33, and his wife, Khalida, 26, were racially abused by a middle-aged woman on a Sydney train on Wednesday afternoon . Stacey Eden, 23, overheard the racist rant and stood up for the Muslim couple . The Brisbane couple's mosque in Holland Park has offered Ms Eden and her partner an all-expenses-paid trip to visit the Gold Coast for a night and to see their mosque . Police are urging anyone who witnessed the attack, caught on camera, to come forward .

Kim Davies bought Llanwenarth House, where Cecil Frances Alexander wrote the lyrics to All Things Bright and Beautiful, for £675,000 in 2008 . But he then made dozens of illegal alterations to the Tudor manor in rural Wales . He installed a whirlpool bath with shiny mosaic tiles, crystal chandeliers and spotlights in the ceiling . Davies, 60, initially denied five charges under the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 . But shortly before his trial was scheduled to start at Newport Crown Court he pleaded guilty to the charges .

A new Facebook graph reveals the favorite baseball teams in the country by sorting through people's likes and breaking down winners by county . The New York Yankees and Boston Red Sox come in first and second respectively in terms of the number of people who claim them as their favorite . Also making a very impressive showing are the Texas Rangers and Atlanta Braves, who have fans across a wide area in the South .

Cui Hongfang, 73, died after she was knocked over by the 38-year-old Canadian woman . Her husband said the tourist was rushing down a steep set of steps on the Mutianyu section of the Great Wall when she bumped into his wife . Police interviewed the tourist, identified by Chinese media as Debra Fortin, and ruled the death an accident . Victim's family filed a civil lawsuit against the tourist and demanded she be prevented from leaving China .

Never-before-seen photographs show the horror of the doomed Gallipoli landings through the eyes of the soldiers who survived Winston Churchill's infamous operation . Historian Stephen Chambers has collected more than 100 rare photographs, many taken by the troops themselves . Soldiers are seen being hosed down on the deck of the SS River Clyde, a mule is hoisted on board the ship and even the moment a soldier makes the dash across No Man's Land has been captured for posterity . The disastrous campaign failed spectacularly, with 250,000 Allied troops injured or killed in vain . In January 1916, after huge losses on both sides, the Allies successfully evacuated their soldiers from the peninsula .

Manny Pacquiao and Freddie Roach laughed after receiving a customised speed ball from celebrity lawyer Robert Shapiro . Shapiro, 72, is a civil litigator working out of Los Angeles-based firm Glaser Weil Fink Jacobs Howard Avchen & Shapiro . He represented OJ Simpson in 1995 when the former NFL player successfully fought charges that he murdered Nicole Brown and Ronald Goldman in 1994 . The Filipino faces Floyd Mayweather on May 2 at the MGM Grand Garden Area in Las Vegas .

The Department of Twin Research, which hosts the biggest adult twin registry in the UK, recently performed a poll of voting preferences . The aim was to explore how much nature and nurture influence our party political allegiances and potential voting preferences so we can draw broader conclusions about people’s voting habits . Identical twins were more likely to vote the same way than non-identical twins . This suggests an underlying genetic influence was stronger than environmental or random factors .

This page includes the show Transcript . Use the Transcript to help students with reading comprehension and vocabulary . At the bottom of the page, comment for a chance to be mentioned on CNN Student News. You must be a teacher or a student age 13 or older to request a mention.

A finger-width flexible tube called an endobronchial ultrasound (EBUS) allows doctors to see inside the lungs and take a tissue sample in one go . The procedure involves inserting the EBUS down the throat, guided by a tiny camera fitted to the tube . An ultrasound scanner attached to one end of the tube takes a scan while a small needle takes a sample . Findings from a three-year trial at UCLH reveal the method halves the time it takes between a patient’s first hospital appointment and for a decision to be made on the best course of treatment . Joe Root scored 182 not out in the morning session on day four of the second Test in Grenada . West Indies batted themselves into a comfortable position on 202 for two at stumps . Root admitted that the flat pitch made it too easy to score runs and too tough to take wickets . England need early wickets with the new ball, just like James Anderson .

More than 200 Yazidi prisoners have been set free in northern Iraq after nearly a year in Islamic State captivity . The 216 prisoners, made up of women, children and the elderly, are said to be in poor health and bearing signs of abuse and neglect . They were piled onto a minibus that drove them to peshmerga positions southwest of Kirkuk . The freed Yazidis were taken away by ambulances and buses to receive treatment and care .

Mazzy, who suffers from Spina Bifida, was on board a Southwest Airlines flight over the US when the entire airplane sang her happy birthday and moved her to tears . Mom Brein Bjorson Marzano was flying with Mazzy and her other daughter Birkly from Tampa to Pittsburgh on their way home from vacation . The crew fashioned Mazzy a birthday cake made from toilet paper and a princess crown out of pretzels .

Patrick Kramer is a 33-year-old artist hailing from Springville, Utah, who specialises in hyper-realistic oil paintings . The Utah-based artist builds up layers of oil paint in order to achieve the intense level of detail . His portrayals vary between vivid city scenes, still-life objects, portraits and breathtaking motion-shots .

43% of voters think Ed Miliband 'comes across as wanting to win the most' when compared to David Cameron . But only 25% of people think he wants to win most, compared to 43% who believe Miliband is most up for the fight . Just 7% thought Mr Cameron was enjoying the campaign the most out of all the main party leaders .

Me-Bai was sold to provide rides for tourists in Thailand when she was three-and-a-half years old . She didn't see her mother, who also worked in the trade, for three years . The small elephant left the tourism trade 'because she was too young [and] began to lose weight and could not carry the tourists any longer' The emotional moment the pair were reunited was captured on camera in the Elephant Nature Park sanctuary in the north of the country .

Paris Saint-Germain ace Zlatan Ibrahimovic has been banned for four matches . Ibrahimovic lost his temper during PSG's 3-2 defeat at Bordeaux on March 15 . The Swede lambasted referee Lionel Jaffredo and one of his assistants . The 33-year-old has scored 102 goals for PSG since joining the club in July 2012 .

Hamza Parvez, 22, travelled to Syria in May 2014, telling his parent he was going to Germany . Along with his best friend Mohammed Nasser, a Roehampton University graduate, went to Syria and joined Islamic State . He is now living with a group of English speaking fighters, originally as far as Belgium, Finland and Australia . Like Hamza, all his friends appear to be struggling with life as a bachelor, with several taking to social media to voice their annoyance at being unable to escape their lonely life in Syria .

Change4Life is promoting dishes on its website with up to 29g of sugar per serving . Apricot Bread Pudding has slightly more sugar than a Snickers bar, which has 27g . Cardiologist Dr Aseem Malhotra, of Action On Sugar, said he found advice 'disturbing'

Chris Christie appeared on The Tonight Show Wednesday evening, and called out Jimmy Fallon for his weight jokes about him . After Fallon told Governor Christie he 'looked great, what the hell's with all the jokes every night?' Then, to make amends, Fallon gave Christie his favorite food - ice cream . Fallon however pulled out two spoons thinking the men could share the ice cream, at which point Christie took the treat for himself, slowly moving away . Christie meanwhile has not yet announced if he plans to run for president in the upcoming election, but he said he will not be changing himself just to win office .

Kennel Club says seemingly harmless foods such as hot cross buns and onions can be killers . Around 56,000 dogs were treated for poisoning between 2010 and 2014 . Painkillers were the most common cause of poisoning, followed by rat and mouse bait . Dark chocolate is particularly toxic and can cause sickness, diarrhoea and fits .

Duffel bag containing human remains was found on Loughery Way in Cambridge, Massachusetts . It was spotted outside a building used by biotechnology company Biogen Inc, one block away from police station . It comes as more human remains have been found in common area of apartment complex . Suspect, who will not be identified, has not been charged with homicide . Instead, they are 'under arrest for accessory after crime of assault and battery'

Ulrike Berger, 44, is barred by a court order from leaving the country with daughter Kaia, 7 . They are believed to have boarded a plane from New York to Germany on March 22 . Police say the pair were last seen at Berger's home in Boerun Hill, Brooklyn, on March 21 .

Romelu Lukaku's agent Mino Raiola said he would never have sanctioned his £28million move to Everton . Raiola hinted that Everton are just a stepping stone for Lukaku on his route to the top . Everton beat Southampton 1-0 at Goodison Park on Saturday night .

Yannick Bolasie scored a hat-trick for Crystal Palace against Sunderland . Referee Anthony Taylor sprinted past Lee Cattermole before the goal . Chelsea defender Gary Cahill has won back his starting spot alongside John Terry . Arsenal goalkeeper David Ospina has kept six clean sheets since replacing Wojciech Szczesny . Manchester City captain Vincent Kompany has struggled for form during the past few weeks . West Brom players wore coloured boots on 'Jeff Astle day'

Ayyan Ali, 21, has been in Rawalpindi prison since March 14 after she was caught with over $500,000 in her carry-on bag at Benazir Bhutto International Airport . She was charged with attempting to illegally transport more than the legal $10,000 cash limit out of the country . Her lawyers say she had yet to check in and was going to hand the money over to her brother . They claim she is being targeted because of her celebrity status . Many in Pakistan's fashion world think she was manipulated into carrying the money .

Manchester United beat Aston Villa 2-0 at Old Trafford to make it five Premier League wins on the bounce . Juan Mata has been in fine form for Louis van Gaal's side this season . The 26-year-old says United need to look at the next seven games as 'finals' The Spaniard has found his best form at a crucial part of the season .

Staff at Silcock's Amusement Arcade in Southport found baby girl in disabled toilets . Baby girl named April by staff at Ormskirk hospital where she is being treated . Police believe she may have been 'born where she was found' hours before she was discovered . Officers say they have found the mother of baby April at an address in the Merseyside area . Police released CCTV image of a woman they were looking to trace earlier today .

Ten former Atlanta public school educators, convicted earlier this month of racketeering in one of the largest U.S. test-cheating scandals, were told to consider plea deals or face significantly more time behind bars . Fulton County Judge Jerry Baxter urged the defendants during the sentencing hearing on Monday to accept deals with the prosecution in the trial over a widespread conspiracy to cheat on state tests . He also threatened prison sentences for them if they fail to reach those deals . 'I've got a fair sentence in my mind and it involves going to jail for everybody,' said Baxter . The sentencing will resume on Tuesday .

Nagoya University and the University of Tokyo in Japan studied stone tools used by people in the Early Ahmarian culture and the Protoaurignacian culture, living in south and west Europe and west Asia around 40,000 years ago . They found the human tools were no more effective than Neanderthal-created tools of the same era . The discovery means we may need to rethink the reasons humans survived Neanderthals - and that we may not have behaved as differently as we thought .

Maksims Uvarenko has not been paid by CSKA Sofia since joining the club in January . Latvian goalkeeper has had to ask his parents to send him money to pay his rent . CSKA have already issued a desperate plea to fans to provide emergency financial backing to avoid expulsion from the Bulgarian top division over debts .

Francis Pusok, 30, had been seen riding a horse through the desert of San Bernardino on Thursday afternoon . He was caught by a helicopter and Taser-jolted with a Taser after he fell off the horse . He tried to get up but they stunned him again before kicking him in the groin . By the end of the two minutes, there were eight deputies surrounding and beating him . San Bernardino County sheriff, John McMahon, has ordered an inquiry into the incident .

Tottenham sold Gareth Bale to Real Madrid in 2013 for a world-record £85m transfer fee . Tottenham chairman Daniel Levy is planning a new transfer policy for the club . Levy reportedly told the Tottenham Hotspur Supporters' Trust that future transfer policy would involve the purchase of young players, priced between £10-15m with good potential for resale . The strategy would set Tottenham back a decade to a time when they traded stars such as Michael Carrick and Dimitar Berbatov to Manchester United .

PayPal is developing a new generation of edible passwords which stay lodged in your stomach to let you log in . Jonathan Leblanc, the company’s top developer, said that the devices would be powered by stomach acid and include mini computers . He said that technology had become so advanced that it allowed ‘true integration with the human body’ The next wave of passwords will be edible, ingestible or injectable and will remove the need for what he called ‘antiquated’ ways of confirming your identity, such as fingerprint scanning .

Hawaii scientists say a supervoid may account for an anomaly in the cosmic microwave background radiation (CMB) of the universe . The theory was proposed by astronomers seeking to understand what is causing this larger-than-expected cold area . In 2004 astronomers first found the 'Cold Spot' - a region 20 per cent less dense than elsewhere - and may now have an explanation for its formation . The research was carried out by the Institute for Astronomy at the University of Hawaii at Manoa . If confirmed, the supervoid would be the largest single structure ever found by humanity . Photographs show teenagers and people in their early 20s kissing in public, drinking alcohol and living openly gay lifestyles . Some of those pictured are even seen wearing clothing adorned with the Stars and Stripes . Young people represent the largest societal bloc in Iran, with over 63 per cent of Iran's population of 73 million people aged under 30 . Young activists have influenced Iran's political agenda since 1997 .

Dimitri Harrell, 21, 'pulled out gun and pointed it at Samirria White, 19, in St Paul, Minnesota, on Sunday . Allegedly shot her in the face at close range while holding their three-month-old daughter . Couple had been arguing over his 'infidelity' in bedroom of their apartment at 3.40am . Now, Harrell has been charged with second-degree murder and faces up to 40 years in prison . Miss White's 16-year-old brother, who heard gunshot, ran into room and found his sister dead . Harrell had 'trust issues' with Miss White after having two children by another woman, relatives said .

Firm will show off the watch to the public for the first time from tomorrow at its retail stores and several special popup stores around the world . Customers in Australia, Canada, China, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, the UK and the US can try on and experience Apple Watch at their local Apple Store or at Galeries Lafayette in Paris, Isetan in Tokyo, Selfridges in London and select Apple Authorised Resellers in Japan and China .

Barack Obama has held the fewest state dinners since Harry S. Truman . Truman, who became president in 1945, held six dinners during nearly eight years in office . Obama held his first state dinner toward the end of his first year in office, honouring then-Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh . The White House state dinner is the highest diplomatic honour the U.S. reserves for allies and other countries . The State Department pays the entire tab, which averaged about $500,000 each .

Luis Suarez was clearly Liverpool's player of the season last season . The Uruguayan scored 31 goals in all competitions . Steven Gerrard, Daniel Sturridge, Raheem Sterling and Phillippe Coutinho also played well . Coutinho scored the winner in the FA Cup semi-final win at Ewood Park . The Brazilian had the most shots, most touches, the highest duel success, highest dribble completion and the most tackles .

Spanish police have killed a man in his 70s who barricaded himself into his home in Zaragoza . He shot at the officers who raided the home in the north-eastern city and shot him dead . The man yelled 'enter if you have the balls' before an intense firefight ensued . His daughter has been pictured lying next to her injured partner outside the house . The 50-year-old man is in a serious condition in hospital after being shot twice in the shoulder .

Robert Durst's lawyers say he got the money legally and it is not needed for evidence or subject to forfeiture in any of his legal proceedings . Authorities who arrested Durst in mid-March found $44,000, marijuana and a revolver at his hotel room in New Orleans . They also found maps of Florida and Cuba, leading some to believe he was ready for a life on the run .

A woman who may be a 'possible DUI driver' led the California Highway Patrol on a slow-speed chase, and even stopped at traffic lights, through Los Angeles for almost an hour, officers said . The CHP became aware of the woman after someone called 911 to report there was an erratic driver in a black SUV on a freeway in Orange County around 12:30pm Wednesday . Unlike typical police chases, the woman wasn't speeding and was driving at 35 and 40mph, CHP officer Juan Galvan said .

Richard Eckersley is currently training with La Liga side Elche . The former Manchester United and Burnley full-back is a free agent . The 26-year-old has been hampered by injuries throughout his career . He has been at Toronto FC and New York Red Bulls since last year .

In 84 days from November 2013 to January 2014, the area around Azle, Texas, shook with 27 magnitude two or greater earthquakes . Now scientists believe these earthquakes were the result of high-pressure injection of drilling wastewater into the ground . The oil and gas industry uses injection wells to get rid of wastewater, which can have chemicals, heavy metals, salt and radioactive material . The timing and location of the quakes correlates better to the drilling and injection than any other possible reason . This adds to other studies that linked injecting wastewater from energy wells to a tremendous jump in earthquakes in Oklahoma and southern Kansas .

Uber driver was filmed by passengers as he sang along to a radio broadcast while driving in Boston, America . At first the driver lets the radio take command and Pavarotti’s distinctive voice can be heard from within side the cab . He then begins singing along himself - loudly so that he is audible above the radio and the sounds of the road . Passenger filming then says: 'Wow, that was brilliant. Thank you very much'

More than 500,000 people knock on the doors of Abbey Road studios every year only to be told that it is closed to the public . The studios hosted the world's first live global broadcast - from none other than The Beatles - as well as playing a role in the invention of stereo by EMI engineer Alan Blumlein . With the aim of sharing some of this history with the public, Google has stepped in to showcase it to a range of ways . Inside Abbey Road is a new web app that takes users on an interactive, immersive and hugely detailed virtual tour of the studios .

Bayern Munich host Eintracht Frankfurt in the Bundesliga on Saturday . Pep Guardiola has only 14 healthy players at Friday's practice . Defender Mehdi Benatia is ruled out for up to four weeks with a hamstring injury . Arjen Robben and Franck Ribery are also absent from Bayern Munich's squad .

Scottish First Minister said Miliband simply 'won't have the votes to say that he is going to do what he likes come what may' She reiterated her call for Labour to 'work together to lock the Tories out' It came after Miliband said he would not enter into any deal with SNP after election . But Ms Sturgeon said 'I suspect Ed Miliband will change his tune once the votes are cast'

Dashcam footage shows police in the borough of Kinnelon race to the incident just after 6 p.m. on Thursday following a tip-off about someone driving erratically in the local area . When officers Mark Ehrenberg and Ricky Ferriola arrived on scene, smoke was already coming out of the woman's white 2006 Toyota Solara convertible, which had been turned upside down . The woman pulled from the wreck had to be hooked up to a defibrillator at the scene and CPR was administered, but she is now doing okay . Dawn Milosky has been charged with driving while intoxicated and having an open container of alcohol in the vehicle .

Nafir Afzal said teenagers are at risk of 'jihadimania' and warned 'another 7/7' could happen . He said children are 'manipulated' by Islamists and that Britain needs a new approach in the way it deals with radicalisation . The former head of the Crown Prosecution Service in the north-west said: 'The propaganda the terrorists put out is akin to marketing, and too many of our teenagers are falling for the image' Hundreds of young Muslims are thought to have travelled to Syria to join ISIS .

Michael David Ikeler, 36, of Torrance, California, charged with three counts of sexual assault in relation to the abduction of a two-year-old girl from a car wash on April 2 . The little girl, who has not been identified, was found alone and naked in a parking lot at Jim's Burgers, 13 miles away . Police had released CCTV footage of the car - a white Nissan Altima - from the crime scene at the self-serve car wash in Gardena, California . Monsour Alshammari, 27, is in the U.S. on a Saudi government student sponsorship and has ties to the country's royal family, according to court documents . He is being held at a facility in San Diego until he can be extradited back to Utah where he faces rape charges related to the rape of a student in February . He had been charged on April 3 with rape, a first-degree felony, and obstructing justice .

Robert Charles Bates, 73, accidentally shot dead Eric Courtney Harris, 44, in Tulsa, Oklahoma . Reserves deputy thought he had his stun gun when he opened fire, police say . Harris was allegedly trying to buy drugs and a gun from undercover officers posing as dealers in the parking lot of a dollar store .

Frank Lampard spoke of his support for gay footballers in an interview on Alan Carr's Chatty Man . The Manchester City midfielder said he'd 'love' to see a gay footballer come out and be fully respected by the public . Lampard was joined on the show by Denise van Outen, Noel Fielding and Lethal Bizzle . The on-loan Manchester City star said that football is evolving for the better .

Efan James was found lying face down and unresponsive the morning after his mother took him to bed . Hannah James, 26, had been to a party and had 'a little to drink' before she, her baby and a friend all shared the bed . The next morning Efan was found ‘face down, unresponsive’ and could not be saved . Pembrokeshire Coroner Mark Layton said current advice on 'co-sleeping' is 'confusing'

A 38-year-old man jumped into Brush Creek in Kansas City, Missouri, early Friday morning after being stopped by police . Police say the suspect spent 10-15 minutes swimming in chest-deep water in the middle of the creek . He was taken to an area hospital to be treated for injuries to his arm and leg . The suspect may face charges in connection to a hit-and-run crash .

SNP leader Nicola Sturgeon said the 'direction of travel' was towards independence . But David Cameron warned of 'frightening' prospect of SNP holding Labour to ransom . Warned of 'chaos' if Labour forced to rely on SNP to pass laws and budgets, England, Wales and Northern Ireland will pay the price .

Stud farm owner Sonia Sharrock watched in horror as her stud farm in Maitland, New South Wales, rapidly flooded . Her brother-in-law Steve Spowart dived down into the freezing cold water to cut the barbed wire and free the horses that had become tangled in fences . The animals’ owner praised her ‘absolutely amazing’ brother, for his incredible feat, saying ‘I don’t know what I would have done without him and my sister’

Pep Guardiola remains Manchester City's first choice to replace Manuel Pellegrini . Bayern Munich boss has a year remaining on his contract but a quarter-final Champions League exit could help persuade his employers to let him go this summer . Guardiola is seen as a natural fit given his close relationship with two of City's executive pair Ferran Soriano and Txiki Begiristain, with whom he worked during a glittering stint at the Nou Camp . In 17 matches on the road in Europe, Guardiola's teams have won just four times, drawing eight and losing five .

Harry Kane is nominated for both the PFA Player and Young Player of the Season awards . The Tottenham striker has scored 20 Premier League goals this season . Kane is up against Eden Hazard and Alexis Sanchez for the top prize . The video features some of Kane's best goals and celebrations from the season .

Dr Oz, 54, is the vice chairman and professor of surgery at Columbia's College of Physicians and Surgeons . Harvard-educated doctor joined the faculty at Columbia in 1993 . Dr Henry Miller of California's Stanford University led the effort and he was the first person to sign the letter .

Fashion Targets Breast Cancer, the charity founded by Ralph Lauren in 1994, has cast plus-size models in its new campaign for the first time ever . Starring models from sizes 10 to 20, this year's focus is all about uniting women of all shapes . Campaign showcases clothes from high street giants including Marks & Spencer's and Debenhams .

Everton defender Leighton Baines is a big music lover . The Toffees defender is friends with rocker Miles Kane and Arctic Monkeys' front-man Alex Turner . Baines admits that he doesn't know any of One Direction's hit songs . He also reveals that Mark Ronson and Bruno Mars' Uptown Funk is regularly played in Everton's dressing room . The England international also gives his thoughts on Ed Sheeran and Meghan Trainor songs .

Jessica McCarty was arrested on March 20 and faces three counts of first-degree murder for the deaths of Lacey McCarty, seven, Phillip McCarty and five-month-old Christopher Swist in Palm Bay, Florida, in a botched murder-suicide . McCarty allegedly strangled the infant and drowned and strangled her daughter, Palm Bay Police Chief Mark Renkens said . Police say none of the three children were shot or stabbed, but lacerations were found in the home . Christopher, the father of the youngest child, lost his fight for life in the days following the attack . He had nicknames for all of the children and coached the two oldest in little league baseball

Inter Milan have opened talks with Manchester City regarding a deal for Stevan Jovetic . The Serie A club have proposed an initial loan deal for the Montenegro forward . City are willing to listen to offers if they can recoup a significant amount of the £22million they paid Fiorentina for him in 2013 . Vivienne Garton's 10-year-old West Highland terrier Ben was snatched from her garden . She put posters up near her home in Knowle West, Bristol, earlier this month . But shortly after she received two phone calls from an anonymous man threatening to cut up the dog . The caller gave the address of an empty house in Bristol and a phone number which she handed to police . Police are investigating an incident of blackmail .

A six-month-old kitten was found lying on the ground covered in maggots and blood . It was taken in by a local vet clinic, My Vet Animal Hospital, who shared the story of aptly-named 'Seven' on social media . The cat had suffered a broken jaw, broken leg, broken hard palate and bruised lungs . Since then, the cat has won the hearts of many who have donated funds to help pay for his medical bills and surgeries . Doctors say Seven will be ready for his new home in about six weeks time .

Lucy Garrod, 27, developed an ulcer known as a corneal abrasion, caused by bacteria growing under her lens . She had worn contact lenses for 12 years with no problems, but woke up one day with an irritable right eye . She said it felt like it had swollen to the size of a golf ball and rushed to see her GP . She was given eye drops, but two days later her eye was so bloodshot she went back to hospital . Tests revealed she had a bacterial infection which grew under her right lens . Doctors said the ulcer was growing on the surface of her eye, millimetres away from blinding her . She spent a week in hospital,

Fossicker Ashley Manzie found the medal in an east Melbourne park with his metal detector last week . The medal belonged to Frederick Biddulph, who served with the 23rd Australian Infantry Battalion at Gallipolli between 1914 and 1915 . Mr Manzie posted photos of the medal to an online fossicking forum, which led him to Sydney man Stephen Norton - Frederick's great-nephew . Mr Norton, who has been researching his family history for 'a very long time' says the discovery has raised more questions than it has answered . He thinks the inscribed medal doesn't belong to Frederick at all, but to his brother Lewis William Bidulph . The men changed their names

Ian Bell hit his 22nd Test match century to rescue England after a top-order collapse in Antigua . Bell and Joe Root put on 177 for the fourth wicket after England's top order collapsed . West Indies pace trio Jerome Taylor, Kemar Roach and Jason Holder bowled with discipline and skill . Jonathan Trott's return to the team ended with a three-ball duck when he fended his third ball to slip . Gary Ballance was the third to fall to a bad shot with just 34 on the board . England captain Alastair Cook was dismissed for 11 runs after making a mess of his batting order .

Lib Dem leader is touring the country in a bright yellow election battlebus fitted out with a radio studio . Aides say it is part of a deliberate strategy to get the Deputy Prime Minister out of London to meet people as they go about their daily lives . He has flown down a zipwire at a Go Ape park, tested the water at Bath Spa, planted flowers in Newtown, painted a picture at a nursery in Sheffield and watched racing wheels coming off the production in Chippenham . Food and drink has played a big part in the campaign, from pulling pints in a Bath pub, to sipping cocktails in the sun in Southampton .

Anderson shoved Otacilio Neto off the ball to earn a red card in Porto Alegre . Neto also saw red after appearing to aim an elbow at Anderson in the first half . Anderson threw his shirt to the ground and shouted 'I'm leaving, I'm leaving' Internacional's Fabricio was also sent off for swearing at his own fans .

Rescue teams were called to Meadowbank in Sydney's west about 11pm on Wednesday with reports a man was trapped in a drain . Firefighters, paramedics and police extracted the man from the hole using ropes and ladders . The 160kg man sustained injuries to his shoulder and leg . It's unknown how the man fell down the two-metre drain .

Izaak Gillen of Oregon City was taken to hospital on April 6 with the injury and was pronounced dead the next day . The state medical examiner's office determined the child's manner of death was a homicide after conducting an autopsy . No arrests have been made in the incident and investigators are still looking into what led up to the injury . Justin and Stacy Gillen, the boy's parents, said on Wednesday in a statement that they are deeply saddened by the loss of their son .

The cute calf had been taking a stroll through the bush with his mother at Idube Game Reserve in South Africa . But when the baby elephant rushed to catch her up he appeared to get his leg caught in the grass . Eventually he fell over and landed - trunk first - down in the mud . Luckily he did not appear to hurt anything but his pride and was quickly back on his feet .

West Brom beat Crystal Palace 2-0 in their Premier League clash at Selhurst Park . James Morrison headed West Brom ahead in the second minute with a header from a corner . Craig Gardner scored a long range strike to give West Brom the lead in the first half . The Baggies now sit eight points clear of the bottom three in the Premier League .

Scientists say they have detected gases used in anaesthetic as far a field as Antarctica . The gases are potent greenhouse gases that have 2,500 times the impact on global warming compared to carbon dioxide . They are capable of storing far more energy from the sun than carbon dioxide, say scientists . An estimated 280 tonnes of anaesthetic gases are used every year .

Many smartphones on sale today come with built-in FM chips . However, nearly two thirds of these devices don't have the feature activated . Broadcasters, including the BBC, are calling for this to change . Many mobile phone network providers are reluctant to allow this because it would reduce demand for data used by streaming internet broadcasts . Norway has become the first country to announce it will switch off its FM radio service in 2017 and other countries are expected to follow .

Kyle Walker suffered a heavy blow from a collision with Kieran Trippier during Tottenham's 0-0 draw with Burnley on Sunday . The England defender sustained the injury following a heavy collision with the defender at Turf Moor . Walker has been provided with a protective boot to ensure no further damage is caused .

Haley Fox, 24, of Turner, Oregon, fractured 26-year-old Samuel Campbell's skull with a baseball bat at her home last Wednesday . She has been charged with first-degree assault . Fox and Campbell, of Adger, Alabama, had been in a relationship for around two years after meeting online .

Raymond Towns­end, a manager at US Limousine on Long Island, New York, was found liable for sexual harassment against his dispatcher Geralyn Ganci, now 32, after more than a year of lurid messages . The woman, who sat near Townsend's wife in their office, repeatedly refused Townsend's requests for sex . She kept a text from her boss where he said she lost her job because she 'refused to have sex with the General Manager' He also sent her texts saying that he 'had to pull over to the side of the road and masturbate thinking about me'

Eddie Hearn has offered Carl Frampton £1.5m to fight Scott Quigg in Manchester . Quigg is the defending WBA super-bantamweight champion and wants to fight Frampton in July . The bout would be held at Manchester Arena on July 18 . But the promoter has offered a cheque to Sky TV cameras in a bid to force a deal with the IBF champion .

Exposure to small, sooty particles alters the structure of the brain, scientists have found . US researchers examined the brains of more than 900 people aged more than 60 and over . They found evidence that living near congested roads or polluted areas can lead to ‘silent strokes’ which in turn cause shrinkage of brain and other damage .

Kim disbanded the group of hand-picked teenagers shortly after the death of his father in December 2011 . Now that the country's official three-year mourning period for Kim Jong-il has concluded, the dictator has demanded his advisers find suitable new women for the role . The previous members retired and were married off to military generals when they hit their early 20s . Tradition was established by Kim Il-sung - who is considered the founder of North Korea .

Nasa's Messenger spacecraft is currently 18 miles (29.1km) above Mercury . It is expected to smash into the planet's surface on 30 April . But as it drops closer to the surface, it is sending back some of the most detailed images ever obtained of the smallest planet in our solar system . Among the features it has revealed are patterns of distinctive hollows - each around a couple of hundred metres wide - in the bottom of a huge impact basin . Another image shows a meteorite crater that has almost completely filled with lava on Mercury's northern volcanic plains, leaving just the hint of a rim .

Eugene in the United States has been awarded the rights to host the 2021 IAAF World Championships . The decision was taken by the International Association of Athletics Federations Council . Doha, home to the Aspire Dome, beat Eugene to host the 2019 event . The 2007 World Championships held in Osaka, Japan was also awarded without a bidding process .

Ellie Harrison, 37, says she knows she will be replaced on the BBC show . The mother-of-two joined the show in 2011 and has defended her image . In December 2014 she revealed she was told to tone down her blonde hair . In 2011 she was asked to be 'less present' a comment she believes was directed at her hair .

One of Australia's most loved cooks, Lyndey Milan, has teamed up with Aldi to create Easter lunch recipes that will easily feed six people for less than $6 each . The home cook icon put her skills to the test by trawling the supermarket aisles to find healthy, fresh produce to turn into an Easter feast . The results of her Aldi experiment include Greek lamb with salad and zucchini pilaf and herb crusted salmon with pea puree, smashed potatoes and carrots . Her hot cross bun and Easter egg bread & butter pudding with almond praline came in at $2 per person .

Marc Wabafiyebazu, 15, has been arrested for felony murder and his brother Jean, 17, was shot dead after a gunfight erupted during a drug deal on Monday . Their mother is Roxanne Dubé, the recently appointed Canadian Consul General in Miami, who was only recently appointed to the role of consul general in Miami . The boys had driven to a house with a third friend to reportedly purchase two pounds of marijuana at a cost of $5,000, and driven to the house under the guise of making said purchase in their mother's BMW with diplomatic plates . Police believe the two young men were armed with guns as they tried to rob a group of men

Glen Walford, 75, has been embroiled in a legal battle with Worcestershire County Council since her mother Mary moved to a care home in 2006 . The theatre director intended to retire to the £205,000 house in Stourport-on-Severn . Council agreed that the house should not be taken into account when means testing was carried out on her mother’s finances . But in 2013 they reversed their decision and said she would need to contribute towards bills . Council took the case to the Court of Appeal, arguing that although the property may be her home, it was not at the time her mother was taken into care . A judge ruled in favour of the council

Romelu Lukaku is Everton's top scorer this season with 18 goals . The Belgium international is hoping to strike up a partnership with Arouna Kone . Lukaku was speaking at a Kick It Out session at a school in Liverpool . Everton beat Burnley 1-0 in their Premier League clash at Goodison Park .

Margaret Hesketh went in to the Royal Albert Edward Infirmary in Wigan on October 28 last year . She was admitted with an infected bed sore and suspected pneumonia . Ten days after she was admitted a scan had revealed she had cancer . Her family claim she was then put on a discredited Liverpool Care Pathway-style treatment for the dying . But they claim a post-mortem found no sign of cancer in the grandmother-of-six, and that she died of pneumonia while malnourished .

Lindsey Vonn spoke about her relationship with Tiger Woods on the Late Night With Seth Meyers . The 30-year-old has been dating golf's former No 1 since 2013 and has become close with Woods' children . Vonn was pictured accompanying Woods' two children around the Masters at Augusta . The most successful US Alpine skier credited Woods with helping her recovery from injury that kept her out of 2014 Winter Olympics .

£135,000 was spent trapping and moving water voles from the Somerset Levels ahead of dredging work . Environment Agency says it has a legal duty under EU-backed regulations to protect the creatures as an endangered species . In January and February 2014 residents on the Levels were forced to abandon their homes after rivers burst their banks following years of insufficient dredging . More than 600 homes and 17,000 acres of farmland were inundated with quickly rising waters .

Celtic U17 side beat Rangers 2-0 to win the Glasgow Cup at Hampden . Josh Kerr took advantage when the Scotland under-17 star missed a corner and missed it to put the Hoops in front . Robby McCrorie dropped a Mark Hill free kick over the line to give Celtic the lead in the 74th minute .

British physicist Stephen Hawking has sung Monty Python's Galaxy Song . Song is being released digitally and on vinyl for Record Store Day 2015 . Professor Hawking, 73, appeared on film alongside Professor Brian Cox . He can be heard in the video whizzing through space in his wheelchair . The song is a recreation of the song from 1983 film The Meaning of Life . It is a cover of the show's famous Galaxy Song, released digitally this week .

Franz Beckenbauer believes Mats Hummels is at the right age to leave Borussia Dortmund . The Germany defender has been linked with a big-money move to Manchester United . The 26-year-old has admitted he is considering his future at Dortmund . Germany legend says he is 'reflecting' after a 1-0 defeat by Bayern Munich .

UK's biggest payday loans firm Wonga racked up a £37.3million loss last year . Revenues declined to £217.2million in the period, down by almost £100million . City watchdog has forecast just three or four payday lenders out of 400 will be left standing following introduction of new rules in January .

Anne-Louise van den Nieuwenhof was diagnosed with a rare bone and soft tissue cancer, called Ewing’s sarcoma, aged just five . Her parents were told she only had three months to live and she was told she wouldn't even live to see her sixth birthday . She defied all the odds and moved to Canada where she worked as a nurse and began raising her own family . She died suddenly at a Canadian hospital six days after giving birth to her second child . Her husband Ryan is now tasked with raising their two-year-old son Emerson and newborn Elizabeth as a single parent .

Hector Bellerin has impressed in the absence of Mathieu Debuchy at right back this season . The Spaniard scored his second Premier League goal in the 4-1 win over Liverpool . The young Spaniard beat Theo Walcott's 40 metre club sprint record last summer . He shaved a hundredth of a second off his time, prompting Walcott to reclaim his title .
